summary: Shamlat deh land status; amendment to Punjab Village Common Lands Act, 1961 s.2(g)(ii-a) effective 1985-07-09; quasi-permanent allotment to displaced persons; land transfer by sale pre-1985; displaced person definition; quasi-permanent meaning; Jamabandi 1963-64 recording land as Shamlat Deh; Chakotadar lease; unauthorized possession post-lease expiry; eviction upheld; amendment applicability examined; final protection determination.
legal_provisions_cited: Punjab Village Common Lands (Regulation) Act, 1961 s.2(g)(ii-a)
final_judgment: Appeal dismissed; eviction order upheld; amendment not applicable to petitioner's case; possession deemed unauthorized.
